text.home.title: Creating spaces that feel
text.home.intro: Sixth Street Creative brings art, interiors, and people together — building collections and creative moments that feel personal, layered, and entirely at home.
text.approach.title: Making your space feel layered and
text.approach.copy: Art should create a little tension, a little curiosity, and a reason to look twice. We pair a curator’s eye with a collaborator’s flexibility to help each project find its own visual language.
text.mediums.intro: From original paintings to large-scale murals and expressive wallcoverings, I embrace bold expression to bring your space—and your vision—to life.
text.medium.murals.name: Murals
text.medium.murals.copy: Site-specific work that turns walls and architectural surfaces into memorable visual moments.
text.medium.paintings.name: Paintings
text.medium.paintings.copy: Original works selected and placed to bring personality, tension, color, and story into a space.
text.medium.wallpaper.name: Wallpaper
text.medium.wallpaper.copy: Pattern, illustration, and custom wallcoverings that make the surface itself part of the art program.
text.artists.title:
Built through
creative relationships.
text.artists.intro: A growing register of artists Sixth Street Creative has collaborated with, sourced from, represented, or placed in projects.
text.work.title: Spaces are the canvas.
text.work.intro: Explore residential, hospitality, and commercial projects through a dedicated portfolio built to let the work lead.
text.about.title: A creative practice
text.about.intro: Sixth Street Creative grew from Rowanne's path through jewelry design, artist relationships, curation, and a lasting belief that art should make a space feel more personal.
text.journey.title: Creative Journey
text.journey.intro: The studio today is shaped by years of making, curating, connecting artists with clients, and building creative relationships.
text.journey.rowanne.name: Rowanne Designs
text.journey.rowanne.label: The foundation
text.journey.rowanne.copy: A jewelry design business where Rowanne first developed her eye for materials, composition, craftsmanship, and creating pieces with a distinct point of view.
text.journey.collective.name: Nashville Artist Collective
text.journey.collective.label: The community
text.journey.collective.copy: A chapter shaped by artists, relationships, and curation — connecting original work with people and places in a thoughtful way.
text.journey.studio.name: Sixth Street Creative
text.journey.studio.label: The studio today
text.journey.studio.copy: Art consulting and creative collaboration brought together under one studio, with an instinct for the unexpected and a point of view that stays personal.
text.portfolio.title: Past Projects:
text.portfolio.intro: Art consulting and creative collaborations across residential, hospitality, and commercial environments.
text.portfolio.residential.name: Residential
text.portfolio.residential.copy: Original art and considered placement for homes that feel collected rather than decorated.
text.portfolio.hospitality.name: Hospitality
text.portfolio.hospitality.copy: Art programs and creative direction that give hotels, restaurants, and gathering spaces a memorable sense of place.
text.portfolio.commercial.name: Commercial
text.portfolio.commercial.copy: Art consulting for workplaces and public-facing environments where brand, culture, and human experience meet.
text.portfolio.noteTitle: Built to grow with the work.
text.portfolio.noteCopy: Each category is structured to become a full project gallery with individual case studies, project photography, artist details, and notes on the creative process.
text.footer.title:
Have a space,
an idea, or both?
text.footer.copy: Sixth Street Creative works with clients, designers, architects, artists, and brands to create spaces with a point of view.
text.about.name: Rowanne McKnight
